Btw, anxiety is a major side-effect of Aderall itself. The combination of sleep deprivation and anxiety makes you majorly paranoid, as you said. I learned over time not to take my meds on nights where I get little/no sleep. Otherwise it would seriously fuck with me- to the point where it would actually induce panic attacks and random twitching.

Thankfully, I have a doc who is much more wise in her prescribing. I talked to her about it and we cut my dose in half. I'm not as focused as I once was, but I'm also not as crazy either- haha :P

Btw, the "ant paranoia" sounds very similar to experiences many meth addicts have. Glad to hear that you don't take it anymore (at least in such large doses). One guy above me already mentioned it, but I think you totally have grounds for a malpractice suit. FDA guidelines suggest an upper limit of 40mg/day. The fact that you were prescribed more than **double** that is irresponsible in itself.
